title: Air-popped popcorn
summary: A big bowl for few calories.
steps: Heat a large pot with a lid over medium heat with no oil, add the kernels in one layer and cover.
Shake the pot every few seconds so the kernels don't scorch, and take it off the heat when the popping slows to one pop every 2 seconds.
Or microwave the kernels in a brown paper bag folded shut twice for 2 to 3 minutes, stopping when the popping slows the same way.
Season while warm with a pinch of salt, paprika or chilli. Skip butter and oil: they can add more calories than the popcorn itself.
